messages.subject: Seeking feedback on ggplot2 GUI
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

As you may (or may not) be aware, I am extending Deducer  (www.deducer.org <http://www.deducer.org>) to cover the plotting system ggplot2. While the GUI is by no means finished, all of ggplot2's functionality has been implemented. I'd be interested to hear any thoughts from people who download and try it. Here is a screencast of the GUI in action:

 http://neolab.stat.ucla.edu/cranstats/vlog3.mov

and the development version of Deducer can be downloaded with:

install.packages("Deducer",,"http://www.rforge.net",type="source")

If you don't already have Deducer working on your machine, follow the instructions:

http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/index.php?n=Main.DownloadingAndInstallingDeducer

Best,
Ian

messages.subject: Support for data.tables?
messages.body_plain:
I have started using data.tables (the data.table package) quite a bit.  You can think of it as data.frames on steroids.

What would it take for me to be able to view data.tables within the Deducer viewer, etc.?  Currently data.tables are extending data.frames and are easily convertible to data.frames (with as.data.frame()).

The structure of a data.table is as follows:

structure(list(a = structure(1:3, .Label = c("a", "b", "c"), class = "factor"),
    b = 1:3), .Names = c("a", "b"), class = c("data.table", "data.frame"
), row.names = c(NA, -3L), sorted = "a")

As you can see, the class indeed does extend "data.frame", but my data.table variables do not appear in the Deducer viewer.

Although, I could convert my data.tables to simple data.frames to use Deducer, I have to convert it back before I can continue -- which is (unnecessarily) tedious.

Is there a way Deducer could work with data.tables?

Thanks,
Harish

messages.subject: Bug in Ubuntu
messages.body_plain:
Ian,

Saw your presentation at UseR 2010 (spoke to you briefly at the Rev
Analytics mixer) and finally got all the packages installed on my
Ubuntu Lucid 10.04 netbook.  Details:

R 2.11.1
Open-jdk
JGR 1.7-1
Deducer 0.3-3

When I enter library(Deducer) in the JGR window, I get the following
message:

Note Non-JGR console detected:
	Deducer is best used from within JGR (http://jgr.markushelbig.org/).

The data viewer pops up, but I get no other menus.  I can get the text
menus if I use deducer().

I will try the latest version of Deducer off of r-forge.net <http://r-forge.net> on my 64
bit Ubuntu desktop when I get back home and see if I get the same
error.

Michael
